notes.title: かぞえ飯1.1.0
notes.content:
New mode added.
New Skill Prohibit Mode has been added.
　In the skill prohibited mode, you cannot use skills. In addition to being able to count rice more realistically
The joy of accomplishment will be increased.


Newly added "One-shot Correct Answer" mode.
　In one-shot correct answer mode, you can only press the answer button once.
　If the answer is wrong, the incorrect letter and the answer will be displayed, unlike the normal mode.
　In addition, if you answer incorrectly, you will not be able to use the chopsticks any more, and you will need to delete the save data of the corresponding mode and start over if you want to press the answer button again.


A new colorful mode has been added.
　In the colorful mode, rice is available in 24 different colors, and a palette is added to change the color of the rice.
　Otherwise, it is the same as the normal mode, and the correct answer is given by guessing the number of rice.




Addition of settings.
Volume setting
　The volume can now be adjusted for each type of sound, such as background music and sound effects.


Screen Settings
　It is now possible to change the picture quality, screen mode, FPS vertical sync and maximum value.


Desk Color
　The color of the desk can now be changed to one of six different colors (wood, white, black, blue, green, or pink) on the pause screen during the game.


BGM
　The BGM has been limited to "Higurashi," but now four BGMs that remind one of the four seasons can be selected on the pause screen.

Other fixes/b]
A sound is now played when rice is held.
Fixed a bug in the UI when playing in English.
　The UI of the skill selection screen has been modified so that icons and text do not overlap.
A note regarding seed values has been added.
Fixed a UI bug that occurred when the screen size was reduced to a certain size in window mode.
　Fixed a bug that caused the UI to be cut off.

Fixed a fatal bug that caused rice to increase.
　A bug that caused a small amount of rice to increase when using a skill, due to a design error, has been fixed.
　However, when playing on a computer with low specs, the game may crash at a stage where rice is not generated in time, or rice may be reduced by pressing the exit button. If you quit the game after less than a minute or if the game crashes immediately after selecting a mode for the first time, we recommend that you delete your save data and start over. This problem will not occur after the second time you start the game with a new saved data.

notes.title: かぞえ飯1.0.17
notes.content:
Fixed a bug in the auto-save function.
　Fixed a bug that the positions of the bowl and counter were not saved when auto-save was performed.

Notes
　Added note about the Seed function.

notes.title: かぞえ飯Ver1.0.15
notes.content:
Reverse rice rotation function
　The rice can now be temporarily reversed by holding down the Ctrl key.
Switching the display of the operation explanation UI
　A check box has been created to show/hide the operation explanation UI on the screen where the Esc key is pressed during a game. This checkbox is reset to "Show" each time the game is started to prevent the user from not knowing how to return to the menu screen in the event of a problem.
Bug Fixes
　Fixed a bug that when the counter was moved, the text of the correct answer was also moved together.

notes.title: かぞえ飯Ver1.0.13
notes.content:
Seed value
　After generating a world, the seed value is now displayed in the upper right corner of the screen where the Esc key is pressed.
　If you enter this seed value on the title screen and then start the corresponding mode, the same number of rice will be generated.
For example, you and a friend can count the same number of rice and compete with each other. 

Other Fixes
　Fixed a bug where skills that had not been released would become available when the game crashed.

notes.title: かぞえ飯1.0.10GPU load reduction, etc.
notes.content:
About the GPU Load Reduction
　As a temporary measure, we have lowered some image quality to reduce GPU usage by two-thirds. This is a temporary measure, but we have lowered the image quality in some parts of the game to reduce GPU usage by about two-thirds.

(The developer's PC is an RTX3060, and while the GPU utilization used to be 100%, we were able to reduce it to 60-70%. This percentage may vary depending on the environment in which the game is run).

Some UI fixes
　Fixed a bug that caused some UI interruptions when playing in SteamDeck or Window mode.

notes.title: かぞえ飯1.0.8　English support, etc.
notes.content:
English support
　Most UI can now be changed to English.
Language can be changed from the title screen.
Mode selection order changed.
　Previously, the buttons were arranged in the order of Normal, Easy, and Hard. The order of the buttons was Normal, Easy, and Hard, but the order has been changed to Easy, Normal, and Hard since this update.
Some UI fixes
　Fixed a bug that caused inappropriate UI to be displayed when using certain skills.

notes.title: かぞえ飯Ver1.0.7Auto save and other bug fixes
notes.content:
Automatic save function implemented.
　The game is now automatically saved every three minutes.

Fixed a bug in some skills.
　Fixed a bug that caused rice to float in the air and not be able to be moved when a remote catch was activated while the rice was already being picked up.

Fixed a bug that caused the camera to move when the rice was cleared.
　The camera position is now reset to default when the number of rice is answered correctly.
